title: Lemon
tagline: Rust-based Telegram wallet adapter & Solana signing bridge
problem: Interacting with Solana dApps from messaging clients typically forces users through custodial plaintext key bots or fragmented mobile deep-links.
description: A high-throughput Telegram wallet adapter written in Rust, inspired by Phantom and Backpack. Coordinates session-scoped transaction signing, balance inspection, and Solana RPC dispatch directly through an ergonomic conversational interface.
impact: Separates command parsing from Ed25519 signing pipelines using async Rust workers and structured state machines.
architectureNotes: Async Tokio dispatcher handling concurrent Telegram webhook/long-poll updates without head-of-line blocking
Deterministic transaction simulation pre-flight check before submitting signed payloads to Solana RPC nodes
Strict session state isolation for multi-account keypair derivation and SPL token transfer workflows

title: Solana On-Chain Programs Suite
tagline: ERC-4626 tokenized vault, atomic PDA escrow & delegated allowance contracts
problem: Composable DeFi primitives on Solana require deterministic PDA derivation, overflow-safe share accounting, and strict CPI signer verification.
description: A collection of native and Anchor-based Rust smart contracts implementing an ERC-4626-style yield vault standard adapted for Solana SPL tokens, alongside trustless two-party escrow and delegated token allowance programs.
impact: Enforces zero-trust account ownership checks, proportional share mint/burn math, and atomic settlement via Program Derived Addresses.
architectureNotes: ERC-4626 Vault: Calculates share-to-asset exchange ratios with checked fixed-point arithmetic to prevent rounding exploits
Escrow Engine: Locks maker SPL tokens in a vault PDA and executes atomic swap settlement upon taker fulfilment
Allowance Module: Enables scoped, revocable delegated spending approvals across SPL token accounts

title: Wiki — Real-Time Community & Task Backend
tagline: Event-driven collaborative backend with WebSockets and SQLx/PostgreSQL
problem: Community learning and task platforms suffer from stale client state when concurrent updates rely solely on request-response polling.
description: A low-latency backend service built for a 'learning in public' engineering community. Combines compile-time checked SQLx queries over PostgreSQL with persistent WebSocket rooms for real-time task synchronization and activity feeds.
impact: Delivers strongly-typed relational persistence paired with multiplexed WebSocket event broadcasting.
architectureNotes: Compile-time verified SQL queries via SQLx with connection pooling and transactional task state transitions
Room-scoped WebSocket hub broadcasting state deltas to connected subscribers in sub-millisecond fan-out
Structured authentication middleware and role-scoped access control for community milestones

title: Solana SPL Token Launchpad
tagline: Client-side SPL token mint initialization & authority management toolkit
problem: Deploying custom SPL tokens with on-chain metadata and granular mint/freeze authority controls requires orchestrating multiple atomic instructions.
description: A browser-based Solana launchpad utility that constructs and batches mint account allocation, metadata initialization, and initial supply distribution into a single wallet-signed transaction.
impact: Streamlines multi-instruction SPL Token creation with client-side transaction assembly and wallet adapter integration.
architectureNotes: Batches SystemProgram.createAccount, initializeMint, and associated token account creation into one atomic transaction
Supports configurable decimals, metadata URI attachment, and optional mint/freeze authority revocation
Direct Solana Wallet Adapter integration with real-time RPC confirmation tracking

title: Endroite Media Pipeline
tagline: Automated Telegram media compositor & audio-visual processing bot
problem: Applying consistent audio tracks and visual LUT/filter transformations to user-submitted media manually is slow and error-prone.
description: An automated Telegram bot built in TypeScript that ingests images and video streams, runs non-blocking media compositing and audio muxing pipelines, and returns processed assets.
impact: Automates multi-stage stream ingestion, filter application, and temporary buffer cleanup.
architectureNotes: Asynchronous media job queue preventing memory exhaustion during concurrent video transcoding
Deterministic temporary file lifecycle management and stream piping
